channel.title: AI GridWatch — New Jersey data center updates
channel.description: Data center moratoriums, proposals, and community-impact headlines for New Jersey, from AI GridWatch.

item.title: East Brunswick: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Broad zoning ban on data centers, adopted the same night as North Brunswick and Stafford Township after advancing through council earlier in the summer

item.title: Millville: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Board of Commissioners banned data centers citywide, calling them"incompatible with the City's land use planning objectives,infrastructure capacity, and community character." The vote killedthe A1 Data Center, a 2.9 million sq ft / 66-acre proposal thatwould have drawn roughly 1.4 GW -- the largest data center everblocked in New Jersey. Millville borders Vineland, where theDataOne/Nebius campus was already under construction

item.title: Bayonne: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: City Council voted 5-0 to add data centers to the list of non-permitted uses citywide, after months of resident organizing.Introduced at the July 2026 council meeting

item.title: North Brunswick: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Banned data centers the same night as East Brunswick and StaffordTownship

item.title: Stafford Township: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Banned data centers the same night as North Brunswick and EastBrunswick

item.title: Pemberton Township: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Ordinance 10-2026 prohibits the construction and operation of datacenters township-wide. One of the earliest municipal bans in thestate

item.title: Harrison Township: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Gloucester County township banned data centers; the exact adoptiondate is not given in the coverage read

item.title: Logan Township: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Gloucester County township banned data centers after the mayorknocked down rumors of a large facility ('Earth Station-76') thetownship says was never formally proposed

item.title: East Greenwich Township: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Adopted an ordinance prohibiting future data center developmentafter resident opposition to the Mt. Royal Data Storage Facility, a16,000 sq ft proposal American Tower withdrew. The adoption date isnot given in the coverage read
